t: Look up to the roof of the Peel Wing of BBC Broadcasting House. There stands Breathing, a glass and steel column about ten metres high, shaped like an inverted torch and decorated with words. It's a memorial to journalists and associated staff killed while doing their work. The sculptor is Jaume Plensa, a Catalan artist who also designs opera sets and acoustic installations. A poem by James Fenton is part of the piece. It glows gently at night, and at ten every evening it sends a beam of light up into the sky for thirty minutes.
